name: Query Expansion
description: Generates multiple reformulations or hypothetical answers for a query to widen retrieval recall before ranking results.

name: Reranking
description: Re-scores an initial candidate set with a cross-encoder or LLM judge to push the most relevant chunks to the top before generation.

name: Recursive Retrieval
description: Uses a hierarchy of summary and child nodes so retrieval first narrows to the right document, then drills into the right section.

name: RAG Agent
description: Wraps one or more retrievers as tools an LLM agent can call autonomously while reasoning over multiple steps.

name: RAG Evaluation
description: Scores retrieval quality (hit rate, MRR) and generation quality (faithfulness, answer relevance, context precision) automatically.
